premises.text: Current charging methods are inconvenient and require multiple pads for multiple devices
premises.evidence_span: Charging is a terrible experience. Thankfully, last Tuesday, a famous smartphone maker came with the solution, a new charging technology, the charging pad.

premises.text: Existing magnetic charging technology is limited to devices placed perfectly parallel to the receiver
premises.evidence_span: But until today, magnetic charging was very limited. You had to put a device down perfectly parallel to the receiver to get any power.

premises.text: Pi can charge multiple devices simultaneously at different angles
premises.evidence_span: We've got five devices now charging simultaneously at different angles from just one Pi.
